<!---
Thanks for filing an issue 😄 ! Before you submit, please read the following:

Search open/closed issues before submitting since someone might have asked the same thing before!
-->

# 🐛 bug report

<!--- Provide a general summary of the issue here -->

Can't use React Fragments. 

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)

<!--- If describing a bug, tell us what your babel configuration looks like -->

Default babel config

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

<!--- Tell us what should happen -->

React Fragments should be supported by default.

## 😯 Current Behavior

Using Fragments will make babel throw error

<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior -->

<!--- If you are seeing an error, please include the full error message and stack trace -->

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4456380/48755816-a11aac80-ecd1-11e8-899e-e6ba2539ba3f.png)


## 💁 Possible Solution

<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix/reason for the bug -->

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/master/packages/core/parcel-bundler/src/transforms/babel/jsx.js#L45

should set the `pragmaFrag` for React.

review_comments: We will need to create a mapping similar to the one for pragma for other react-alike libraries (preact etc.) if they also support fragments.

@lili21 Do you have an idea for how to do this?

EDIT: did some research, see below.
